macro.title: US-Iran Talks
macro.body: The ongoing US-Iran talks could lead to a significant reduction in tensions, potentially affecting global oil prices and the overall market sentiment. A successful outcome could lead to increased investor confidence, while a failure could lead to increased volatility.
macro.bull: A successful outcome could lead to increased investor confidence, benefiting the portfolio's leveraged positions.
macro.base: The talks may not yield a significant outcome, leading to a neutral market reaction.
macro.bear: A failure in the talks could lead to increased tensions, negatively impacting the portfolio's leveraged positions.

macro.title: Fed Policy Shift

macro.base: The Fed may maintain its current stance, leading to a neutral market reaction.
macro.bear: A hawkish stance could lead to decreased investor confidence, negatively impacting the portfolio's leveraged positions.
